title: F. prausnitzii potentially modulates the association between citrus intake and depression.
authors: Samuthpongtorn C, Chan AA, Ma W, Wang F, Nguyen LH, Wang DD, Okereke OI, Huttenhower C, Chan AT, Mehta RS.
figures: Identification of gut microbial species and metabolic pathways that may modulate relationships between citrus intake and depression. To understand the role of the gut microbiome in modulating the association between citrus intake and depression ,  we primarily leveraged data from the prospective Nurses’ Health Study II (NHS2), comprised of 32,427 middle-aged women, free of depression at baseline,

Citrus intake is inversely associated with depression, possibly via modulation of  F. prausnitzii .
